课程简介（中文）

欢迎来到中国古诗词的奇妙世界！本课程专为国际学生量身定制，打破语言壁垒，带你穿越千年时光。我们将围绕“爱情、送别、山水”等七大引人入胜的主题，精选最脍炙人口的中国古典诗歌名篇。通过生动有趣的赏析与沉浸式的诵读实践，你将不仅能读懂这些千古绝唱，更能深刻领略中华诗词的音韵之美与文化底蕴。快来加入我们，开启一场诗意盎然的文化探险吧！

 

课程简介（英文）

Welcome to the wonderful world of classical Chinese poetry! Tailor-made for international students, this course breaks down language barriers and takes you on a journey through thousands of years of history. We will explore seven captivating themes, such as love, farewells, and nature, featuring the most celebrated masterpieces of classical Chinese poetry. Through engaging analysis and immersive recitation practices, you will not only understand these timeless verses but also deeply appreciate the rhythmic beauty and cultural profoundness of Chinese poetry. Join us and embark on a poetic cultural adventure!

教学目标

  • 【感知中国之美】 (Experience the Beauty of China)：在跨文化视域下，引导学生零距离感受中国古典诗歌的魅力，汲取深厚的文化智慧与东方哲学。 / From a cross-cultural perspective, we guide students to intimately experience the charm of classical Chinese poetry, absorbing its profound cultural wisdom and Eastern philosophy.
  • 【提升语言通关力】 (Level Up Language Skills)：在诗歌的语境中，轻松提升汉语语感与文化素养，为未来探索更多中国文学与古代汉语宝藏打下坚实基础。 / Naturally enhance your Chinese language intuition and cultural literacy within the poetic context, laying a solid foundation for future explorations of Chinese literature and ancient Chinese.
  • 【培养全球化视野】 (Cultivate a Global Vision)： 激发学术好奇心，培养在不同文化视角间自由切换的能力，探索东西方文明对话的无限可能。 / Stimulate academic curiosity, develop the ability to seamlessly switch between different cultural perspectives, and explore infinite possibilities for cross-cultural dialogue.

教学方式

  • 互动式趣味课堂 (Interactive & Fun Lectures): 告别枯燥说教，我们将诗歌背景故事化，深度解析艺术特色,并辅以生动的朗读指导。 / Say goodbye to boring lectures. We bring poetry to life through storytelling, in-depth artistic analysis, and lively recitation guidance.
  • 沉浸式舞台展示 (Immersive Stage Performances): 将课堂所学转化为艺术表演，组织激动人心的诗歌吟诵会，在排演中体验中国古代文人的风雅。 / Turn your learning into art. We organize exciting Poetry Recitation Galas, allowing you to experience the elegant lifestyle of ancient Chinese scholars through rehearsal and performance.
  • “走出课堂”文化微探索 ("Out of the Classroom" Cultural Micro-Explorations): 视情况，开展第二课堂实地探索活动,将诗词与现实世界连接，提供全方位的浸入式文化体验。 /Depending on conditions, we will organize immersive field trips to connect poetry with the real world, offering a comprehensive cultural experience.

教学内容与进度安排

  • 第1-2周 (Week 1-2): 启航：中国诗学传统漫游 / Set Sail: A Journey through Traditional Chinese Poetics
  • 第3-4周 (Week 3-4): 怦然心动：古诗里的"跨时空爱情” / Heartbeats: "Cross-Time Romance" in Ancient Poetry
  • 第5-6周 (Week 5-6): 离愁别绪：送别与思乡的共鸣 / Bitter-Sweet Partings: Resonating with Farewells and Homesickness
  • 第7-8周 (Week 7-8): 绿水青山：游览与山水间的治愈之旅 / Green Hills and Clear Waters: A Healing Journey through Nature and Landscapes
  • 第9周 (Week 9): 聚光灯下：第一次诗歌吟诵会 / In the Spotlight: The 1st Poetry Recitation Gala
  • 第10-11周 (Week 10-11): 咏怀：倾听古人的心灵独白 / Inner Voices: Listening to the Monologues of the Ancients
  • 第12周 (Week 12): 烽火连三月：边塞与战争的壮烈史诗 / Flames of War: The Heroic Epics of the Frontier
  • 第13-14周 (Week 13-14): 万物有灵：田园牧歌与咏物之趣 / All Things Have Souls: Pastoral Idylls and the Charm of Objects
  • 第15周 (Week 15): 高光时刻：第二次诗歌吟诵会 / Highlight Moment: The 2nd Poetry Recitation Gala
  • 第16周 (Week 16): 期末总结与论文提交 / Final Review and Paper Submission
